stories.summary: Police condemn the "reckless and targeted attack" after the explosive was sent to a Londonderry hotel. A suspicious package delivered to a hotel in Londonderry contained a "viable" explosive device, police have said. Army bomb experts were sent to the hotel at Ebrington Square in the city's Waterside after the package was discovered at about 15:20 GMT on Tuesday. They carried out a controlled explosion on the device, which was later taken away for a forensic examination. Det Supt Kearney of the Police Service of Northern Ireland said: "I condemn this reckless and targeted attack."
